content: based on the actual score, segment by phrase in groups and do an algorithm that allows to transpose the whole phrase using any note of the phrase as a pivot note and setting a target pitch. The pivot note and the target pitch apply for all segments. So, for example, we can use the first note of every segment as a pivot note and set it to E4. This means that all phrases will have their first note at E4. If we set the third note as a pivot note and target pitch at G3, all phrases will transpose their structure so that their third note is G3. If the pivot note is out of range of the group (the pivot note is the 7th note and the phrase has only 6 notes...) the last note is used as pivot.

OK. Algorithm saved as algorithms/help_flow.js and sent to Max, which did not confirm (is the instance "help_flow" in the patch?).
Transformer, checked on the score in the roll (893 notes). In Max its source lives in memory (non-destructive: every run starts again from it).
Parameters (now a panel in Max):
  gap: slider 100..2000 ms = 400
  pivotIndex: slider 1..20 = 1
  target: slider 1200..12700 mc = 6400
  spread: slider 0..1200 mc = 0
Checked in 7 runs (every slider at its minimum and maximum, every option).
Score at the declared values (893 notes, 4 ms):
voice 1: 893 notes in 893 chords, 0-106906 ms, pitch 2300-7000

The phrases of the score are now segmented by silence, and each is transposed as a whole so that its chosen pivot note (1st by default — or the last one if the phrase is shorter) lands on the target pitch; `spread` optionally walks the pivot from phrase to phrase.
